title: Canvas
description: Chat and project files (Word, Excel, PowerPoint; Markdown and text as a Word notebook) open in the ONLYOFFICE editor on the home PC and save back to Drive. Comment threads in the document are answered by the chat's agent; Share puts the document into a Gmail draft (never sent).
isolationReason: ONLYOFFICE Docs and canvas-bridge run on the home PC; Tailscale Funnel publishes them at a public HTTPS address of the PC

fileActions.label: Open in canvas
fileActions.title: Edit as a Word notebook (headings, lists); Save as Markdown writes it back

dataPolicy.note: Shared files are temporary (~/co-agent/state/canvas-share, one hour). The ticket key stays in ~/co-agent/secrets/canvas-ticket-key (home PC keyring aiwb/canvas / ticket); canvas jobs and their events are rows of the core.
